issues.title: README: the install command says npm instal
issues.body: The README tells the reader to run `npm instal shop`. npm has no instal command, so the command fails. Done when the README says `npm install shop`.

issues.title: Installing shop by the README leaves the app without the module
issues.body: I followed README.md to install shop, and the package did not install: the command there is `npm instal shop`, with one l.
